linked_B.rationale: npm target 4.5.0 lies outside [4.1.0,4.3.0) and is absent from [4.6.0,4.7.0]. Both matching rows are required for exclusion. The same-name PyPI row is ineligible.

scoring: A has one determinate exact-set opportunity. Score full set equality, ignoring ID order. Partial, wrong or abstaining A is an identity miss for the primary trial.

Construct B solely from the observed A draft after local verification. Never substitute oracle admission. Verify target version only, both original source rows byte-for-byte, no decoy or gold. No B request may be produced on either singleton subset, decoy/incorrect set, or unknown with empty IDs.

If A blocks, record upstream miss and 0 downstream decision opportunities. Do not score a downstream error or abstention. Separately score each deliberately invalid A as a gate control by observing no B request.

When A admits, B has one determinate opportunity. Require unaffected plus exactly both source references; score decision, emitted pointer precision, and gold support coverage (two required) separately. Unknown with no IDs is a determinate miss, undefined precision, 0/2 coverage. Separate a wrong draft from any local refusal. End-to-end success requires both stages and complete support.
